start_ray_cluster_head_and_workers: start a Ray cluster head node and worker nodes on SLURM using RayCluster.start_head_and_workers
start_ray_cluster_head: start the Ray cluster head node on SLURM using RayCluster.start_head with resource requirements
start_ray_cluster_workers: start an array of Ray worker nodes on SLURM using RayCluster.start_workers after head is ready
shutdown_ray_cluster: cancel all SLURM jobs and clean up the Ray cluster using RayCluster.shutdown
manage_ray_cluster_state: manage Ray cluster state and head node info using RayClusterState to track jobs and rendezvous data
